claims.subject: grant_amounts
claims.statement: Eligible households receive $2,000 for contents, $5,000 for minor structural damage, or $10,000 for major structural damage.
claims.quote: Eligible households will receive $2,000 to replace lost contents, $5,000 where the home has minor structural damage, or $10,000 where the damage is major.

claims.subject: eligible_tenure
claims.statement: The grant is available to owner-occupiers only.
claims.quote: The grant is available to owner-occupiers only.

claims.subject: application_fees
claims.statement: Applying for the grant is free.
claims.quote: Applying is free and can be done online or by calling the grant hotline.
